name: ModelVariant832_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant832_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (up to four bolts leave a model point one after another and fly towards jittered points on the opposing slot, each drawing a star sprite at every point of its ring, wrapped in spinning Gouraud strips and trailing a ribbon; at each origin a muzzle flash of sprites, smoke and embers fades out, and on arrival every bolt flares into a glow with sixteen drifting star motes, shards, debris, sparks, a fan of stretching blades and a growing sixteen-segment shock ring while the ambient light dims and recovers and the camera cuts between cues); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, seeds the bolts, flares, motes, shards, puffs and sparks and packs twelve textures from eleven images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 before the start time, 4 once as each of the first three bolts arrives, 1 once when the last bolt arrives, 2 once the last glow has faded after the light recovers and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-849 and 946 images build it from the same source. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
